title: Tutorials audit
description:
Verify every CLI/storage/structure/semantics claim in `docs/tutorials/` against current source and fix all drift class-wide.

## Background

`docs/tutorials/` (4 files — `first-workflow.md`, `parallel-work-worktrees.md`, `quickstart.md`, `README.md`; 867 lines including the README) is one of the disjoint-footprint areas in an exhaustive, source-verified documentation audit covering the whole adopter-facing documentation surface. Tutorials walk a reader through real command sequences step by step, so drifted CLI surface or renamed flags break them outright for new adopters. Recurring drift classes to sweep for include invented CLI surface, stale storage-format specifics, over-credited guarantees, legacy or future narration, and prerequisite/environment drift.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Every documented command and flag in `docs/tutorials/` exists in the current generated CLI schema or the current clap definitions.
- [hard] REQ-02: Every repository-relative link, heading anchor, source citation, and addressable-item citation in `docs/tutorials/` resolves.
- [hard] REQ-03: Every diagram-shaped block in `docs/tutorials/` is Mermaid; directory trees and verbatim command output are not diagrams.
- [hard] REQ-04: Every factual claim in `docs/tutorials/` about CLI behavior, storage layout, repository structure, or engine semantics matches the current source tree; where a drift instance is found, its whole class is swept across the footprint, not patched line-by-line.
- [hard] REQ-05: Prose in `docs/tutorials/` states current behavior only — no legacy or future/roadmap narration remains.
- [hard] REQ-06: Every volatile fact in `docs/tutorials/` with an existing projection or citation surface is projected or cited rather than hand-copied; each volatile fact with no such surface is cited to its source file and recorded for follow-up filing.

## Notes

The linked plan document carries the exact check commands and expected outputs (§2).

CLI-surface verification must use a binary built from the current HEAD; a stale installed binary has previously produced false verification results. The generated CLI schema under-reports the real flag surface (clap `visible_alias` flag forms and the global flags are absent from it), so a documented flag absent from the schema is checked against the clap definitions in `crates/jit/src/cli.rs` before being declared invented; only a flag absent from both is a defect.

No box-drawing content is expected in this footprint on the current tree; any found is adjudicated against the directory-tree/verbatim-output carve-out before conversion.

A doc in this footprint found wholly obsolete or redundant may be deleted or merged into another, with the rationale recorded on this task. Every inbound link tree-wide is repointed in the same change — links are uniformly relative markdown, so inbound references are findable by filename in both bare-name and relative-path forms — and no doc is removed before its inbound links are repointed. After any deletion or merge, every link and anchor tree-wide still resolves.

Blast radius: self-contained to `docs/tutorials/`.
